name: 2027 Option 1 — Maximum scored coverage
assumptions: Per-layer mixed-integer optimisation with original audience eligibility, known full-course durations and 4/8/24/4-hour budgets. Coverage only, then fewer hours and fewer resources. No quality weighting. Conditional optima, not a global workforce optimum. Internal learner time is separately budgeted: 3h foundation, 6h Practitioner, 12h technical Expert, 8h governance Expert, 6h leadership and 4h per applicable specialty. No scored coverage credit for internal proposals. Planning duration corrections: TR-158 1h30 means 1.5h; TR-155 official four-module path totals 9h26m (566/60 hours), superseding the catalogue 8h metadata for planning only. TR-159 combines several lab collections and has no total duration, so exclude from auto-selection until scoped. These do not alter assessment scores. Explicit minute durations for INT-271, INT-275, INT-276, INT-340, INT-452, INT-476 and INT-1473 are retained using overrides because the app parser currently treats their parenthesised lecture counts as ambiguous; no content-based score changes.

all.title: B1 Bank AI essentials and safe-use check
all.owner: AI adoption lead with IDP and each domain head
all.outcomes: Map two domain use cases; identify the approved platform, data boundary and safety components; handle a planted error, unsafe request and spoofed message. Proposed 1h briefing, 1h coached case, 1h assessment and feedback.

practitioner.title: B2/B3 Supervision, Skill and evaluation practicum
practitioner.outcomes: Two 2h labs plus 2h observed sign-off: least privilege, inspect independent traces, reject injected or incorrect output, stop/revoke/rollback, hand over, document a Skill with owner and lifecycle, run a small known-answer eval set. Authorisation is per action class; reassess after material changes.

technical.title: B3/B5 Build, evaluate and secure one agent
technical.owner: AI engineering lead and independent security assessor
technical.outcomes: 8h scoped build/evaluation project, 2h attack and recovery test, 2h independent challenge and assessor calibration. Include versioned cases, human-labelled judge checks, external enforcement, safe-stop evidence, cost/drift controls and ownership. Completion does not authorise every agent design. Maintain an assigned AI threat-source watch and brief changes that affect the role.

governance.title: B4-GRC/B5 Evidence-based AI risk and assurance case
governance.owner: AI risk lead with BISO and assurance
governance.outcomes: Prepare one inventory/risk/vendor dossier and action-class policy, challenge the claimed controls using test evidence, calibrate reviewer decisions and record residual risk and accountability. Maintain an assigned AI threat-source watch and brief changes that affect the role.

leadership.title: B6 Leadership decision exercise and quarterly forums
leadership.outcomes: 2h benchmark and autonomy decision exercise plus four 1h forums on value, risk, human capacity, junior skill retention and adoption. No technical or operational authority follows from attendance. Maintain an assigned AI threat-source watch and brief changes that affect the role.

cdc.title: Agent incident response drill
cdc.outcomes: Suspend an agent, preserve independent logs, revoke access, recover safely and work manually.

forensics.title: Agent evidence reconstruction exercise
forensics.outcomes: Reconstruct an agent trajectory from independent evidence, preserve chain of custody and distinguish generated summaries from original artefacts.

idp.title: DLP and classification control case
idp.outcomes: Assess agent data flows, confidential-data leakage and classification errors; N13 only for nominated AI risk assessors.

biso.title: Agent assurance evidence challenge
biso.outcomes: Test controls at the enforcement point and validate the AI used to generate assurance evidence.

testing.title: Contained agent testing exercise
testing.outcomes: Test own agents in an isolated sandbox; enforce scope and stop from outside the model, reproduce findings and manage collateral discoveries.

redteam.title: Specialist agent red-team validation
redteam.outcomes: Run an authorised multi-step attack and validate the full trajectory, boundaries and reproducible evidence.

exposure.title: Agent and connector inventory exercise
exposure.outcomes: Discover MCP/Skills, record sponsor/version/permissions, verify content hashes and scan changes.

harness.title: Code-analysis harness validation
harness.outcomes: Evaluate on a known-vulnerability corpus; include patched/unpatched tests, repeatability, deduplication and cost limits.

architecture.title: Agent control-plane design review
architecture.outcomes: Specify action tiers, external authorisation, immutable evidence, stop levers, tenancy and usable oversight.

iam.title: Agent joiner mover leaver and revocation drill
iam.outcomes: Register sponsor and purpose, scope delegation, recertify access and verify session revocation.

iam-expert.title: Agent identity integration and break-glass test
iam-expert.outcomes: Test IGA/PAM/SIEM integration, delegated identity, JIT grants, expiry and independently verified revocation.

cio.title: Vendor decision and adoption review
cio.outcomes: Compare vendor claims against a common bank test set and sign a risk/value adoption decision; no invented role extra.

assumptions: Recommended compromise: use the curated Option 2 pathways and add the full CERT-FR agentic-workstation risk bulletin (TR-127, budgeted at 1h) to foundation. Raise only the foundation course budget to 5h; selected foundation resources take 4h48m. The added bulletin improves assessed coverage of agent components and safe controls, but is a French-language reading, not an operational lab. Confirm language accessibility and use an approved translation if required. Internal-work commitments remain 3/6/12/8/6h for foundation/Practitioner/technical/Governance/leadership plus 4h per applicable specialist branch. Quality review is provisional pending a representative learner pilot. Preserve all catalogue scores; duration overrides correct explicit minute metadata and the current SecAI+ path duration; TR-118 uses a labelled 6h full-bundle planning estimate. No coverage is claimed for internal work before it is evidenced.

rationale.all: INT-437 provides foundational mental models and guided application; INT-2787 adds the distinct cyber-social-engineering threat strand; TR-127 explicitly introduces agent components, restricted permissions and isolation. Provisional quality shortlist; review language/access and pilot the exact enterprise versions before rollout.
